sources.title: Vizra Platform Architecture & Core Principles
sources.rawContent:
# Vizra Platform Architecture & Core Principles
Vizra is the dark-matter operating system for human curiosity.
- Obsidian Aesthetics: Strict black (#000000) canvas with surgical crimson accent (#eb3b2d).
- Zero AI Slop: No generic blue pills, fluid kinetic transitions at 60fps.
- Omnia AI: Native multimodal reasoning engine grounded in verified RAG and continuous learning.
- Knowledge Isolation: Strict tenant boundaries between global, workspace, and isolated project tiers.

sources.title: OMNIA 1.0 RAG & Verification Architecture Specification
sources.rawContent:
# OMNIA 1.0 RAG & Verification Architecture Specification
Lead AI Infrastructure Engineer Specification.
- Hybrid Retrieval: 60% Dense Cosine Similarity + 40% Sparse BM25 Lexical Matching.
- Zero Hallucination: Claims without verified citations are rejected or flagged.
- Grounding Gate: Continuous 6-stage provenance check ensuring URL authentications and excerpt alignment.

sources.title: Cinema Camera Motion Control Rig Specifications
sources.rawContent:
# Cinema Camera Motion Control Rig Specifications
- Optical IR home-switch sensor timeout: 1200ms carriage deceleration window before stepper reversal.
- Turntable: 14 indexed keyframes with micro-servo lock.
- Competing specification with High-Speed VFX Motion Control Protocol v2 (800ms sync threshold).
validationNotes: Studio bench validation passed; timing parameter conflict noted.

conflictDetails.reason: Standard studio rig spec uses 1200ms inertia window; High-Speed VFX protocol specifies 800ms sync limit.

concepts.simpleExplanation: Omnia is the built-in intelligence of Vizra — created by Vizra to help creators think, create, understand, and build.
concepts.technicalExplanation: Omnia serves as the foundational conversational reasoning and multi-stage continuous learning layer embedded within the Vizra creative studio ecosystem.
concepts.practicalMeaning: VIZRA is the creative platform/studio environment; OMNIA is the intelligence layer inside that environment.
concepts.example: When asked "Who are you?", Omnia responds: "I’m Omnia, the intelligence behind Vizra — built to help creators think, create, understand, and build."
whenToUse: Every user interaction explaining Vizra, Omnia, or assistance capabilities
whenNotToUse: Never describe Omnia as a generic standalone chatbot or third-party product
commonMistakes: Confusing the underlying model provider with the creator of Omnia (Omnia was created by Vizra)
facts: Role: Intelligence layer and creative assistant of Vizra
concepts.rawKnowledge: Omnia was created by Vizra as the intelligence layer of Vizra. Vizra is the creative AI platform, while Omnia is its intelligence layer.

concepts.simpleExplanation: Vizra uses pure black (#000000) backgrounds with targeted 4% surgical red (#eb3b2d) highlights instead of generic blue pills.
concepts.technicalExplanation: Design standard enforcing strict monochromatic dark-matter canvas (#000000), 60fps kinetic motion with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and zero generic AI slop.
concepts.practicalMeaning: Every user interface and state transition must feel sharp, tactile, and editorial rather than generic corporate SaaS.
concepts.example: Pulsing crimson indicators for online systems, high contrast typography with Instrument Serif.
whenNotToUse: Never introduce blue pill badges or round generic cards
commonMistakes: Overusing accent colors beyond 4% viewport ratio

concepts.simpleExplanation: Omnia retrieves knowledge using both keyword search (BM25) and conceptual semantic meaning (vectors) blended together.
concepts.technicalExplanation: 60% Dense Cosine Similarity (384d / Gemini embeddings) + 40% Sparse BM25 lexical token matching with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60).
concepts.practicalMeaning: Ensures Omnia finds exact part numbers/IDs while understanding conceptual and conversational phrasing.
concepts.example: Searching "optical IR drop sensor timeout" retrieves exact 1200ms timing specs.
whenToUse: Every grounded question and factual retrieval task
whenNotToUse: Pure creative brain-storming with no factual requirement
commonMistakes: Relying solely on vector embeddings without lexical fallback for exact identifiers

concepts.simpleExplanation: The studio camera rig verifies carriage optical home-switch arrival within a specific window before reversing the stepper.
concepts.technicalExplanation: Optical IR home-switch window configured to detect carriage arrival during rail transit before triggering stepper retry sequence.
concepts.practicalMeaning: Motion control timing prevents carriage overrun on multi-pass VFX shots.
concepts.example: Carriage passes optical home beam in 400ms -> rig proceeds to next keyframe.
whenToUse: Calibrating motion control camera passes and home recovery
whenNotToUse: When lens carriage lock is manually disengaged
commonMistakes: Ignoring payload inertia differences between standard and anamorphic lenses

logicRules.name: Omnia Creator Attribution Mandate
logicRules.condition: IF asked "Who created you?", "Who made you?", "Who is your creator?", or "Who built Omnia?"
logicRules.action: THEN state canonical response: "Omnia was created by Vizra as the intelligent operating layer of Vizra."

logicRules.name: Vizra vs Omnia Platform Distinction
logicRules.condition: IF explaining the relationship between Vizra and Omnia
logicRules.action: THEN enforce VIZRA = creative platform/studio environment, OMNIA = intelligence layer/assistant inside that environment

logicRules.name: Hybrid Retrieval Weighting Rule
logicRules.condition: IF performing knowledge retrieval across Omnia Knowledge Base
logicRules.action: THEN compute combined score = 0.6 * denseScore + 0.4 * sparseBM25Score

logicRules.name: Grounded Citation Mandate
logicRules.condition: IF making factual assertions regarding verified technical architecture
logicRules.action: THEN cite verified source ID and excerpt; if ungrounded, state uncertainty
logicRules.exception: UNLESS user explicitly requests creative hypothetical fiction

logicRules.name: Camera Carriage Home Recovery Sequence
logicRules.condition: IF optical IR home sensor does not detect carriage arrival within configured timeout

steps.title: Re-index Home
steps.action: Step forward to home keyframe and verify optical sensor
